title: Contents Packout & Storage High-Value Condition Check at Unpacking
content:
Contents Packout & Storage high-value items are unpacked with a condition check against the photo inventory. On the pack-back box line of a return: **when the high-value inventory item quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the high-value hourly threshold, the check is charged as technician time, the high-value items times the check hours per item times the tier's contents technician hourly rate; when they total at least one but fewer than the high-value hourly threshold, the check is charged per item, the high-value items times the standard condition-check charge; a job with no high-value inventory item carries no condition check.**

## Method by volume

| High-value inventory items on the job's packout lines | How the check is charged |
|---|---|
| 25 or more (at least the high-value hourly threshold) | technician time: items times 0.25 hours per item times the tier's contents technician hourly rate |
| 1 to 24 | per item: items times 8.75 |
| none | no condition check |

The items counted are the quantities on the itemized high-value inventory lines booked on the job; the hourly rate is the tier figure on the product's schedule of labor charges.

## Cases (hypothetical hourly rate of 40.00, not a tier figure)

- 24 items: 24 times 8.75, or 210.00.
- 25 items: 25 times 0.25 is 6.25 hours, times 40.00, or 250.00.
- 40 items: 10 hours, 400.00.
